statement: Alphabet raised its full-year 2026 capital expenditure forecast to $195-205 billion, up from $180-190 billion, citing accelerated capacity delivery to meet demand.
why: A raised hyperscaler capex range is the most direct forward signal of AI accelerator and data-center order volume, and Alphabet is one of the largest single buyers.

impact.mechanism: A higher capex budget converts into incremental server, accelerator, data-center and networking orders across the AI build chain, lifting demand for merchant GPUs, custom silicon, memory, fabric and power capacity.

evidence.source: Alphabet Investor Relations (press release dated 2026-07-22) via CNBC / MLQ News reporting
evidence.excerpt: Alphabet raised its full-year 2026 capital expenditure forecast to $195 billion-$205 billion, up from $180 billion-$190 billion. Management said the increase reflects an acceleration in capacity delivery to meet demand.

confidence.basis: Figures are corroborated open-web reporting (CNBC, MLQ News) on an official release whose exhibit could not be text-extracted; single fetched secondary document, so capped at medium.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 60.0 -> 200.0 (tol 1%); sources: Alphabet Investor Relations (press release dated 2026-07-22) via CNBC / MLQ News reporting
